question:
The given pie chart shows the number of students admitted in to different classes of a school in the academic year 2022-23.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7cd66c086892215d582ac5fb50302e90310d52942f6120baf462adb374ae92e.png] 

How many students were more in Class 10 than in Class 12 if 600 students were admitted in to Class 8?
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of students in Class 8 = 15%

Percentage of students in Class 10 = 25%

Percentage of students in Class 12 = 18%

Number of students admitted to Class 8 = 600

**Formula used:**

The total number of students can be calculated using the formula:

frac{{Number of students in Class 8} times 100}{{Percentage of students in Class 8}}

**Calculations:**

Calculate the total number of students admitted to the school:

(600 times 100)/(15) = 4000 

Step 2: Find the number of students in Class 10 and Class 12:

Class 10 : (25)/(100) times 4000 = 1000 

Class 12 : (18)/(100) times 4000 = 720 

Calculate the difference in the number of students between Class 10 and Class 12:

Difference: 1000 - 720 = 280 

**The number of students in Class 10 is 280 more than in Class 12.**
